purpose: Teach: 言い換えれ/気がつき/いっさい/ズバリ/いつしか/まいる/解る/はなはだ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんが難しい言葉を言い換えればわかりやすくなるわよ
lines.en: Sho, if I put those difficult words into simpler ones, it'll make more sense to you.
lines.style: Warm, patient opening. Gentle clarification—not lecturing. Soft gaze, slight lean-in. The tone of someone used to making things clear for the people she cares about.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、メイ姉さんの優しさに気がつきにくかった事もあった
lines.en: Mei-sis… I didn't always notice how kind you are to me.
lines.style: Quiet realization. Hesitant, like he's saying something he's been thinking about for a while. Small voice, steady. A child being honest without needing reassurance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんは、いっさいの嘘をつかない人なのよ
lines.en: Sho, Mei-sis doesn't lie—not ever, not about anything.
lines.style: Stated gently but with real weight. A quiet promise wrapped in simple words. No performance. Direct eye contact level in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ズバリ正直に言うと、勉強嫌いだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis… honestly, I really don't like studying.
lines.style: Blunt, relieved. A kid being brave enough to say something true. No apology in it—just straightforward. Small but unafraid.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、いつしか翔くんが、メイ姉さんを越える絵描きになるかもね
lines.en: Sho, you might become an artist who surpasses even Mei-sis someday.
lines.style: Offered almost like a secret. Warm belief underneath. Not trying to convince—just planting something true. Slight wonder in the delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、メイ姉さんのお家にまいるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis… I'm going to come to your place.
lines.style: Direct, eager. The lightness of a child stating something he's decided. No hesitation. A simple joy at the thought.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの絵は解る人にはたまらないのよ
lines.en: Sho, my paintings—people who understand them really love them.
lines.style: Understated pride. Not boasting—just naming something true. A slight warmth, the confidence of someone who knows her own worth without needing to perform it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、はなはだ恐縮ですが、もう一枚絵いただけませんか
lines.en: Mei-sis… could you give me another one of your paintings, please?
lines.style: Formal politeness laced with genuine want. A child using big respectful words because something really matters to him. Earnest, not stuffy. Small pause before the request.
